note: _feci hortos et pomeria_ – I made gardens and orchards; ich ließ Gärten anlegen und Obstgärten. – Only the 5th, 2007 edition of the Weber/Gryson Vulgate has the correct spelling _pomeria_; following the Clementina, the earlier editions have _pomaria_. The Nova Vulgata keeps, incorrectly, _pomaria_.

_silva lignorum germinantium_ – a forest of budding trees. The noun _lignum_ normally means “wood,” but in poetry, it may serve as a word for “tree.” The choice of the word may be inspired by Vergil: _Aeneid_ XII, 767, Lorenzo di Fonzo OFM Conv.: _Ecclesiaste_. Torino 1967 (xx, 379 pp.), p. 147. ▲
